fields.name: label
fields.label: Field label
fields.description: Names the search field for screen readers and is the button text, e.g. Search.

fields.name: placeholder
fields.label: Placeholder
fields.description: Optional hint inside the field, e.g. Search for...

fields.name: resultsMessage
fields.label: Results message
fields.description: Shown above the results. {count} is the number of results and {query} the search terms. Give singular and plural forms separated by |, e.g. {count} result for "{query}" | {count} results for "{query}".

fields.name: noResultsMessage
fields.label: No results message
fields.description: Shown when nothing matches. {query} is the search terms, e.g. No results for "{query}". Try another word.
